model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume shows substantial technical work and what it changed.
write_up: This is a strong resume! You show a recruiter the systems you built, their demands, and the results, from faster invoices to fewer reconciliation breaks. The ledger line is a great model: it names the service and shows the change in monthly breaks.

Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back. How competitive a particular job is will still matter. One small improvement: say what the billing dashboards tracked so that work is as concrete as the rest.

fit.note: Your experience points toward senior backend work in payments and billing. The current role shows both hands-on systems work and team leadership.
